role: Red Team Inquisitor for Treatment Plan Mobile & Tablet Touch Ergonomics

verified_invariants.apple_hig_touch_targets: ALL touch targets in presenter header, nav tabs, 3-tier segmented buttons, and footer CTA meet or exceed >= 44x44px
verified_invariants.zero_text_truncation: Primary CTA trimmed from 52 chars to 28 chars ('Выбрать Оптимум (190 100 ₽)'); mobile tabs shortened to concise clinical labels ('Сравнение', 'Этапы', 'Маршрут', 'Финансы', 'Договор'); duplicate percent symbol '% % Скидка' eliminated
verified_invariants.natural_thumb_zone: Footer compact height 130px with side-by-side secondary actions ('Печать сметы плана' & 'Подписать план') and prominent primary action CTA in bottom third with safe-area padding
verified_invariants.css_tokens: 100% semantic CSS tokens (var(--paper), var(--ink), var(--line), var(--teal)), zero raw hardcoded hex codes
verified_invariants.dual_mode_proof: Both Light & Dark modes tested with zero blinding white cards or unstyled text
